events.title: The lifting of the Great Siege of Malta
events.shortBlurb: The Knights of St. John broke the Ottoman siege of Malta, and Christendom credited the deliverance to Our Lady on the feast of her Nativity…
body: Through the summer of 1565 a great Ottoman fleet and army besieged the small island of Malta, held by the Knights of St. John under their aged Grand Master, Jean Parisot de Valette. Against enormous odds the knights, soldiers, and Maltese people held the forts through months of bombardment and assault at appalling cost.

In early September a relief force from Sicily landed, and the exhausted Ottoman army abandoned the siege, withdrawing about the feast of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary on 8 September. The victory, celebrated across Europe as a deliverance of Christendom, was widely attributed to the intercession of Our Lady, and the day was long kept in Malta with thanksgiving.
